name: Tier Gamma Yuri Ship
source:
The Overlord has divined Flora a match and sent her to a tier gamma honeymoon with the lady in question. Nothing weird about this. That's how love life is on planet Overlord. However, to her great dismay, Flora soon learns that her supposed princess charming is far below her: a lowly loiter from the Pits, of all things.

[From [url=https://lezliz.itch.io/tier-gamma-yuri-ship]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
霸主为弗洛拉占了姻缘，并派她与这位女士一起去度伽玛蜜月。这没什么奇怪的。这就是霸主星球上的爱情生活。然而，令弗洛拉非常沮丧的是，她很快就发现，她所谓的白马公主远不如她：一个来自深渊的卑微游荡者。

[来自[url=https://lezliz.itch.io/tier-gamma-yuri-ship]itch.io[/url]]
